title: Not All Errors Matter: Decision-Relevant Prediction Error Predicts Planning Quality
abstract: arXiv:2609.32322v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: World models are typically trained and evaluated by prediction error, assuming that more accurate predictions lead to better decisions. We show that this assumption can fail because models with similar total error can differ substantially in planning performance when their errors occur on different state dimensions. We introduce Decision-Relevant Prediction Error (DRPE), which measures prediction error on the state dimensions that affect decisions. We also develop an iso-error evaluation protocol that varies error allocation while keeping total error fixed. In a factored gridworld with known state relevance and a standardized planner, we evaluate 55 controlled and learned models across different error levels and allocations. Total prediction error is weakly related to planning success (Spearman $\rho=-0.25$), whereas DRPE is strongly predictive ($\rho=-0.84$; $-0.98$ within the controlled family). translated_title: 并非所有误差都重要：决策相关预测误差可预测规划质量
translated_abstract: 世界模型通常以预测误差进行训练和评估，其背后的假设是预测越准确，决策就越好。我们证明这一假设可能失效：当误差出现在不同的状态维度上时，总误差相似的模型在规划性能上可能存在巨大差异。我们提出了决策相关预测误差（DRPE），用于衡量那些影响决策的状态维度上的预测误差。我们还开发了一种等误差评估协议，在保持总误差不变的情况下改变误差的分配方式。在一个具有已知状态相关性和标准化规划器的因子化网格世界中，我们评估了55个受控模型和学习模型，涵盖不同的误差水平和误差分配。总预测误差与规划成功之间的相关性较弱（Spearman ρ=-0.25），而DRPE则具有很强的预测能力（ρ=-0.84；在受控模型族内为-0.98）。总误差仅相差1%的模型……
tldr: 该论文提出决策相关预测误差（DRPE）新指标，证明只有发生在影响决策的状态维度上的预测误差才能有效预测规划质量（相关性达-0.84），而传统总预测误差与规划性能几乎无关。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Decision-Relevant Prediction Error (DRPE), demonstrating that only prediction errors on decision-critical state dimensions strongly predict planning quality (ρ=-0.84), while total prediction error correlates weakly with planning performance.
